sources.entry: OnionShare - Securely and anonymously share a file of any size. GPL-3.0 Python/deb
OnionShare - Securely and anonymously share files, host websites, and chat with friends using the Tor network.

summary.one_liner: OnionShare is an open source tool for securely and anonymously sharing files, hosting websites, and chatting over the Tor network.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and only describes the project at a high level: OnionShare lets users share files, host websites, and chat with friends using the Tor network. It states that installers are available for Windows and macOS from the project website, with a Homebrew cask for macOS, and that Linux users can install it as a Flatpak or Snap package. Detailed usage, security properties, and contribution guidance are not in the README and are referred to the external documentation. The metadata from the awesome lists describes it as a single-click file transfer tool for files of any size, written in Python and packaged as a deb.
how_to_run: Download the Windows or macOS installer from the OnionShare website
Install the Linux version as a Flatpak or Snap package (see the linked instructions)
notable: Shares files, hosts websites, and offers chat over the Tor network
Available via Homebrew cask on macOS
Linux distribution through Flatpak or Snap
Documentation covers security properties and usage in external docs
caveats: README gives little technical detail; usage and security specifics are in external documentation
Installation on Linux requires a Flatpak or Snap route per the README
